title: Vulnerabilities in WNC T-Mobile 5G Box IDU routers
content_md: CERT Polska has received a report about 6 vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-58146, CVE-2026-58147 and from CVE-2026-40854 to CVE-2026-40857) found in firmware of WNC T-Mobile 5G Box IDU routers. Article Link: Vulnerabilities in WNC T-Mobile 5G Box IDU routers | CERT Polska
